description: §4.18.5 — inside an row, the whitespace-only text between two adjacent interpolations (`${r.f} ${r.l}`) and between two sibling elements (`… …`) is content of the row element's free-text body and renders. impl#1 dropped every whitespace-only run in a row body (emit-each.ts renderTemplateChildToJs), so the rows rendered `PeterOliver` / `AdaLovelace` while the same markup outside rendered correctly. Adopter-reported (assetManagement).
rationale: §4.18.5: "No stage SHALL collapse runs, strip leading or trailing whitespace, or drop the whitespace adjacent to a `${…}` interpolation." and "Whitespace-only text between elements is kept exactly too … SHALL NOT be dropped or normalized." A per-item `<tr>`/`<td>`/`<li>` is a plain-markup element, so its body is a free-text body (§4.18.1; §17.7.7: <each> per-item bodies inherit the classification of their element kind).
